listing.name: JaydeeProficiencies
listing.summary: JaydeeProficiencies is a generic Library Mod used by JaydeePiracy and related projects.
listing.aiSummary: Provides a library framework for customizing player factions, UI colors, and managing hireable specialists with skill trees.

description:
JaydeeProficiencies

JaydeeProficiencies is a generic Library Mod used by JaydeePiracy and related projects.

For Players
Enables the full customisation of the Player Faction and UI color palette in game

Runs a series of validator functions
Validator functions are run on game load.

Attempts to find broken fighter specs, orbits, systems and other common issues. Logged with the prefix JDP_DEBUG.
Adds some console commands
-AddAdmin (Adds administrator, optional starting skill)
-AddFleet (Generates a fleet of the specified faction and adds all officers, ships and crew to the player fleet)
-GenerateEvent (Generate an event, includes Abyssal Lights, Abyssal Planets, Slipstream Ambush etc)
-ListSpecialists (List all active Specialists)
-LevelSpecialist (Add Proficiency XP to a Specialist)

For Developers
Contains the Specialist/Proficiency framework
The Proficiency framework is a system for creating unique hireable NPC Admins, Officers and AI cores with their own skill trees similar to those of the Player Character.

These Specialists are managed within a new Core UI tab, which will appear above the Character Tab when a Specialist is available to manage. See JaydeePiracy for example usecases.

Exposes several vanilla functions to an API like interface using PatchLib, this currently includes new listeners such as WeaponFired and ExperienceGained, and new mutable stats such as a Pather Interest multiplier for markets.

Adds a new hullmod incompatiblity framework that can be used to create automatically reciprocal incompatibility relationships with a "data\config\JaydeeProficiencies\HullmodIncompatibilities.csv". Incompatabilities are loaded and applied automatically.

Several other generic utility functions of varying utility.

aiDescription: Enables full customization of the player faction and UI color palette. Includes validator functions to detect broken game data and adds console commands for generating fleets and events. For developers, it exposes a Specialist/Proficiency framework with unique skill trees for NPCs and AI cores, along with an API interface for vanilla functions and hullmod incompatibility management.
